digest: HEAD stop/cancel/terminal code conflicts with SPEC.md in several places: pollMs default 200 vs 50, cancellation markers widened beyond the exact three, a launchRetries rename that breaks the public launchRetryAttempts field, and message-based stop detection. No tests exist.

reviewLenses.focus: correctness of stop detection and cancellation classification
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: isWorkflowReturnedCancellation now treats cancelled/timeout as cancellation and isWorkflowStopRequestedError matches on message text, which can misclassify provider errors and stop signals

reviewLenses.focus: public summary field names and semantic status mapping
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: SPEC T3 names launchRetryAttempts as a public contract read by external tools, but the code exports launchRetries; the rename is a breaking change

reviewLenses.focus: polling default and minimum interval vs spec
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: SPEC S3 requires a 50ms default and a 10ms floor, but code uses 200ms default and a 1ms floor, which affects stop latency and the spec contract

reviewLenses.focus: unit test coverage for S/C/T items
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: SPEC Q1 requires a unit test per S/C/T item, but no test files were found in the repo, so the regressions above are unguarded

triageSummary: Narrow HEAD change in three src files with high reliability risk. Spec mismatches are concrete: C1 exact markers, S6 name-only check, S3 polling defaults, T3 field name. Verify by reading; no runtime or tests were executed.
skippedLenses: security: no auth or external input handling beyond provider error classification
migration: folded into api-contract-terminal rather than a separate lens
